limitations: Practice is not final ranking; final suppliers are unseen.

Supplier threads within RFQs use the committed sequential runner.
Costs and scores come from the hosted result; durations are measured wall time.
No wave cap is imposed on practice; seed and wave are not applicable.
Provider cost is an estimate; failed-call reservations are retained.
